name: Sports Model Flying Saucer (two tone version)

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable model of a classic retro flying saucer. It features a wide, flat, disc-like main hull with a ring of small hemispherical dome turrets evenly spaced around its top and bottom perimeters. At the center of the top hull is a prominent, hollowed-out cockpit dome with an angled oval opening, while the bottom of the saucer sits on three thin, angled landing legs ending in spherical feet.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, multicolor flying saucer in OpenSCAD. The model should allow users to customize parameters such as the hull radius and height, the number and size of the peripheral turrets, the cockpit dimensions, and the number of landing legs.
captions.factory: The script defines a custom 'dome' module using a scaled sphere with its lower half cut off via a difference boolean. The main hull is constructed from top and bottom halves, each utilizing the dome primitive, with circular cutouts created using cylinders and loops for the radial turrets. The landing legs are built with a combination of cylinders and spheres, positioned programmatically with a for-loop based on 'num_legs'.
